verdict.rationale: Decagon's proactive-agents page claims 'data portability and control' for customer context, which is a first-party claim on this story's axis. It is a single vague mention with no export mechanism, formats, or exit process described, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented full-data export, open/standard export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), coverage of all data types (conversations, AOPs, configs), offboarding/deletion process, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: complementing your systems of record with data portability and control
